credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Georgia O'Keeffe leaning against a flat rock outcrop sketching, dressed in a matching jacket and skirt. Tish is sitting on a rock above her and Doris Bry is walking away from them in the sand. This photograph is part of the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Sketching in Glen Canyon
